summary: Shipped the toggleable cortical-division layer of the 2D live section (docs/SWARM_V9_PLAN.md §2, PLAN.md §5.2). NEW src/components/section/corticalLobes.ts: classifyCorticalPoint(x,y,z) + splitLoopByDivision/splitLoopByDivisionPlane + CORTICAL_DIVISIONS/LABELS/SHORT_LABELS/COLORS + CORTICAL_LOBE_METHOD_NOTE, with the fitted boundary constants (CORTICAL_BOUNDARIES), their measurement and their per-boundary residual in the file header under the caveat 'THIS DIVIDES THE DERIVED RIBBON, NOT A GYRAL MAP'. Boundaries fitted by a reported probe series (.dsh-scratch/cortical-lobes-probe{,2,3,4}.mjs, tune{,2,3,4,5}.mjs, insula-dist{,2}.mjs, map{,2}.mjs, loops.mjs — gitignored task scratch) against committed assets only: dorsal-ridge central-sulcus notch z=-34/-36 (ridge 106->90 at x 20-26) -> z_cs(y) = -57 - 11.5y below the knee, y>=77 above it (residual 0.0 au at both measured endpoints, 5.4 au at the hand-knob reach); lateral fissure anchored on the measured MCA M1 junction (nearest ribbon vertex 3.13 au at 26.4,15.2,20.7) and M2 exit (5.93 au at 33.2,36.6,29.4) -> y_fis(z)=max(15, 30.7-0.46(z-5)) (residual 3.9 au at the M2 exit), gated z<=45 and x>=18+0.055(z+40); occipital z<=-50-0.15y above y=-5, pinned to an 11.05% ribbon share at z<=-52 (PCA P2 z[-16.6,12.4] reported); insula ellipsoid centre (29,22,17) radii (13,16,22) au fitted through that corridor = 15.6x19.2x26.4 mm, holding 3.34% of ribbon vertices and 2.10% of reference-plane area (morphometric series: 1.8-2.5%); limbic = callosal band radii (20,22) au about the measured callosum (y[19.4,63.9] z[-34.8,41.1]) cut at the splenium by y+0.45z>=42, x<=24 (3.4 au = 4.1 mm of cingulate beyond the callosal surface), plus the medial temporal band (x<=22, y<=20, z[-20,17]) which under-counts the parahippocampal gyrus deliberately (lateral edge 22 vs hippocampal lateral edge 31.0). MEASURED SHARES over the 13 reference planes: frontal 47.6%, parietal 27.3%, temporal 12.9%, occipital 6.6%, limbic 3.5%, insula 2.1% (limbic:rest = 1:26.8 vs 1:8-1:20 literature). SectionCanvas.tsx: new drawCorticalLobes pass painting each division's runs (stroked dark casing + colour, translucent fill 0.42) OVER the existing context fill for ctx-hemisphere-l/-r only, division labels at the longest run's inner vertex mapped through the canvas' own uToSx/vToSy, geometry cached per render-order build so the existing memoization is untouched, plus a user-visible 'Cortical divisions' button (aria-pressed, persisted) and a legend that renders CORTICAL_LOBE_METHOD_NOTE verbatim. sectionAssets.ts: SECTION_CORTICAL_RIBBON_SLUGS + isCorticalRibbonSlug. contourWorker.ts: doc-header note only — the partition is deliberately on the main thread so the worker protocol and verify:pipeline cannot regress (PLAN §7.5). VERIFIED: node scripts/verify/cortical-lobes.mjs 200/200 assertions PASS exit 0 — per-plane share table printed (each division non-empty on >=1 plane; insula on y=14 15.2%, y=30 3.4%, z=0 6.0%), containment (every classified cell first proven inside the even-odd cross-section; every loop vertex covered by a run, no alien run point, runs form a closed chain), determinism (repeat + reversed sweep identical, splitter stable), 17 pinned anatomical spot checks, the legend JSX compiled by TypeScript and rendered with react-dom/server (2218 chars of real markup carrying all six labels, their colours and the caveat), and section-pipeline.mjs run as a child requiring exit 0. Frozen gates re-run by me: npm run validate exit 0 (0 errors, 0 warnings), npm run check exit 0, npm run build exit 0, npm run verify:pipeline exit 0 (138/138 parts, 599204 tris, 386 loops, 0 problems), npm run verify:plane exit 0 (10827 assertions), plus boundary-contract 22/22, a11y-contract 28/28, budget-report PASS. HONEST LIMITS: (1) the derived ribbon has NO insular surface — at y=30 the Sylvian corridor is a gap between z 21.5 and 24.9 and at z=20 between y 33.2 and 43.3, so the insula ellipsoid paints the deepest available limen tissue, not real insular cortex; (2) the 3 reference planes y=-46/-24/-8 MISS the ribbon entirely (inferior limit y=-6.803) and carry no division; (3) limbic:rest 1:26.8 vs 1:8-1:20 in the literature — the band is the 1-2 gyrus strip the probe could measure, not the whole limbic lobe; (4) the section lobe layer's browser rendering and the toggle's visual result are ORCHESTRATOR-VERIFIED ONLY (Chrome is denied in this sandbox, audit/acceptance not claimed); (5) npm run verify:anatomy cannot complete here (spawnSync powershell EPERM, PLAN §7.17) so 27/27 is not claimed from the sandbox; (6) pre-existing, unrelated failures I measured and did NOT touch: scripts/verify/audit-checks.test.mjs and closure-bite.mjs fail on 'rows dimmed at default framing' for the vascular rows — reproduced with my three edited files stashed, so it comes from the v8 vascular preset, not from this task. HAND-OFFS: store field sectionLobes + key neuroaxis.sectionLobes are task 4's (src/state/store.ts is outside my write scope); SectionCanvas reads the field defensively and falls back to the persisted key, so the toggle works before and after it lands, and no declaration was added on my side. npm script wanted from the integrator (package.json is integrator-only): "verify:cortical-lobes": "node scripts/verify/cortical-lobes.mjs". Task 4 note: the legend/pass live inside SectionCanvas, so the PiP's second instance shows the same toggle, and both instances share the module-scoped layer state.
